expo.name: Sensory Firewall

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sensory Firewall uses the camera to understand the current scene and only report useful events.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sensory Firewall uses the microphone to transcribe short audio chunks for useful information.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Reserved for future on-device speech recognition support.

expo.description: A default-silent multimodal attention filter that surfaces only information worth interrupting the user for.
